answers.goal: I’m still trying to figure that out but mostly expanding my knowledge in the industry, making meaningful connections and contributing to a beautiful successful project that honours creative storytelling and innovation.
answers.drew: Growing up in LA your constantly surrounded by the entertainment industry from seeing your local street being blocked off due to filming to booking my first background role for a CBS show and to earning a full scholarship through the Hollywood reporter and having a mentor who showed you the behind the scenes of entertainment. PR and Advertising really stood out to me which is why I pursued my degree in communication studies
answers.seeking: Event coordinators, Publicists, communication coordinators , actors, producers, marketing partners… honestly anyone who is kind and wants to grow meaningful relationships with the entertainment industry.
answers.inspiration: Black creatives across the industry that focus on telling black stories. From writers like Shonda Rhymes to amazing actors like Michael B Jordan, Kerry Washington, Marsai Martin and producers and filmmakers like Ryan Coogler, Ava Duvernay, Issa Rae, Mara Brock Akil. I’ll forever be inspired by my community.
answers.favorite: Fresh prince of bel air (original) & Insecure
